name: provable-compliance
description: Proof-of-concept: making a bank's compliance decisions provable on a public blockchain.

scripts.test: npm test -w @pc/shared && npm test -w @pc/circuits && npm test -w @pc/contracts && npm test -w @pc/server
scripts.test:fast: npm test -w @pc/shared && SKIP_PROVING=1 npm test -w @pc/circuits && npm test -w @pc/contracts && PROOF_SYSTEM=dev npm test -w @pc/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pc/circuits && npm run build -w @pc/contracts && npm run build -w @pc/web
